# dna hosting

Web hosting packages and services.

## dna hosting create

```
dna hosting create <domain> [flags]
```

Order a hosting for a domain (charges balance).

Provisioning is asynchronous (HTTP 202). Poll `dna hosting status` until it is ready; the response
then includes panel credentials.

- **Safety:** BILLABLE - charges your balance; asks for confirmation (--yes to skip)
- **API:** `POST /api/v1/hostings/create`
- **Body:** `CreateHostingInput`
- **Returns:** `CreateHostingResponse`
- **Schema:** `dna schema hosting.create` (MCP tool: `hosting_create`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--domain-name` | string | Domain name (required; or argument 1 &lt;domain&gt;) |
| `--service-plan` | string | Service plan from `dna hosting packages` (required) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
